facts.fact: The draft National Health Policy submitted to the National Health Conference of 27 June 2019, with a 2030 horizon, names a single, digitised and integrated medical record as the support for continuity of care and calls for the generalisation of the unique identifier and the digitised medical record to create traceability and reduce waste and corruption; it is a draft policy, gives no cost or timetable for the record in the passages, and is dated here to its publication year.
